`BUILD SUCCESS` — the full suite passes. The task is complete.

## Summary

I added `Task` as its own domain type in `com.example.planning`, nested under `Project`.

**`src/main/java/com/example/planning/Task.java`** — a `@Aggregate` record with:
- `@Id Reference<Task> id`, `@Version long version`
- `@Parent @NotNull Reference<Project> project` — this makes the base path `/projects/{projectId}/tasks` (Prefab derives it from the `project` field name + `Id`)
- `@NotBlank String title`, `boolean done`
- `@Create` constructor `(Reference<Project> project, @NotBlank String title)` → `done` defaults to `false`
- `@Update(path = "/complete", method = "POST")` `complete()` returning the new state with `done = true`
- `@GetById` + `@GetList` for retrieval and listing

No hand-written controllers, DTOs, repositories or migrations — Prefab generates them. The generated agent context confirms the exact four endpoints:

```
GET  /projects/{projectId}/tasks/{id}   (get by id)
GET  /projects/{projectId}/tasks        (list)
POST /projects/{projectId}/tasks/{id}/complete  (update via complete)
POST /projects/{projectId}/tasks        (create)
```

**`src/test/java/com/example/planning/TaskIntegrationTest.java`** — an `@IntegrationTest` covering: create (asserts `done=false`), scoped listing (a task in another project is not returned), and `complete` (asserts `done=true`, `200 OK`).

Verification: `mvn -DskipTests compile`, `mvn -Dtest=TaskIntegrationTest test` (3/3 pass), and `mvn verify` all succeed — `BUILD SUCCESS`, 3 tests run, 0 failures.
